intro: 这一 Part 帮你掌握从闹钟响、赖床、睡懒觉，到睡过头、赶时间以及描述刚起床状态的一整组自然美式表达。
objectives: 听懂并自然使用起床、赖床、睡过头、迟到相关的高频口语。
区分 wake up / get up、sleep in / oversleep、in a rush / hurry up 等容易混淆的表达。
能够用自然美语描述自己刚醒、很困、完全清醒、黑眼圈或眼睛浮肿等晨间状态。

vocabulary.note: 常用于起床后活动身体。

example.en: I always stretch when I get out of bed.
example.zh: 我下床时通常会伸伸懒腰。

vocabulary.note: 通常用复数形式；a pair of pajamas = 一套睡衣裤。

vocabulary.zh: 又钻回床上；重新钻进被窝
vocabulary.note: 比 go back to bed 更有懒洋洋钻回去的画面感。
比 press the snooze button 更口语。

example.en: My alarm goes off at seven.

vocabulary.note: 常见搭配：miss the bus / train / flight。

example.en: I'm in a rush this morning.
Hurry up! We're going to be late.

vocabulary.note: 活泼、熟人间常见的叫人起床说法。
通常带亲昵或玩笑语气。
比 sleepy 稍偏描述性，也常见于药物说明。
常说 dark circles under your eyes。
可作名词或动词。Don't panic. = 别慌。
上下文明确时，口语里常直接说 alarm。

vocabulary.zh: 早上脾气不好；有起床气
不是晨型人；早上通常状态不好
睡得太沉，闹钟响了也没醒
赶紧行动起来；开始动起来
要迟到了；已经比计划晚了
时间进度落后；已经晚于计划
把某人叫醒；让某人清醒

scenes.title: The Alarm Goes Off
scenes.zh: 闹钟响了，但还是不想起床

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Did your alarm go off?
dialogue.zh: 你的闹钟响了吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yeah, but I hit the snooze button twice.
dialogue.zh: 响了，不过我按了两次贪睡按钮。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You'd better get up. It's already seven fifteen.
dialogue.zh: 你最好赶快起床。已经七点十五了。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I know. I'm still so sleepy.
dialogue.zh: 我知道。我还是好困。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Come on. Sit up, stretch a little, and get moving.
dialogue.zh: 快点。先坐起来，伸伸懒腰，开始行动吧。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Okay, okay. I'm up.
dialogue.zh: 好啦好啦，我起来了。

scenes.title: Someone Is Trying to Wake You Up
scenes.zh: 家人、伴侣或室友叫你起床

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Rise and shine, sleepyhead.
dialogue.zh: 起床啦，瞌睡虫。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm awake. I'm just not ready to get out of bed yet.
dialogue.zh: 我醒了。我只是不想现在就下床。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You've been awake for twenty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 你已经醒了二十分钟了。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I know. I'm not fully awake yet.
dialogue.zh: 我知道。我还没有完全清醒。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: At least sit up and open the curtains.
dialogue.zh: 至少先坐起来，把窗帘打开吧。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Fine. Give me a minute.
dialogue.zh: 好吧。给我一分钟。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Are you getting up anytime soon?
dialogue.zh: 你近期有打算起床吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Not really. It's Saturday, so I'm sleeping in.
dialogue.zh: 不太想。今天星期六，我要睡个懒觉。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You've been in bed all morning.
dialogue.zh: 你整个上午都在床上。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I know. I just want to stay in bed a little longer.
dialogue.zh: 我知道。我只是想再赖一会儿。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Fair enough. Are you going back to sleep?
dialogue.zh: 也行。你还打算继续睡吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Maybe. I might crawl back into bed after I get some water.
dialogue.zh: 也许吧。我喝完水以后可能再钻回床上。

scenes.title: I Overslept
scenes.zh: 睡过头，突然发现马上迟到了

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Wait—what time is it?
dialogue.zh: 等等——现在几点了？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It's almost eight.
dialogue.zh: 快八点了。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: No way. I overslept. I must've turned off my alarm in my sleep.
dialogue.zh: 不会吧。我睡过头了。我肯定是在睡梦里把闹钟关掉了。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Don't panic. You still have time if you hurry.
dialogue.zh: 别慌。你快一点的话还来得及。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'm wide awake now. I need to get dressed.
dialogue.zh: 我现在彻底清醒了。我得穿衣服了。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Then hurry up, or you're going to miss the bus.
dialogue.zh: 那就快点，不然你要赶不上公交车了。

scenes.title: Looking Rough in the Morning
scenes.zh: 没睡好，早晨看起来很疲惫

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You look exhausted. Did you sleep okay?
dialogue.zh: 你看起来累坏了。昨晚睡得好吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Not really. My eyes are all puffy, and I've got dark circles under them.
dialogue.zh: 不太好。我的眼睛都肿了，而且黑眼圈很明显。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You do look a little drowsy.
dialogue.zh: 你看起来确实有点昏昏欲睡。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I feel drowsy. I barely slept last night.
dialogue.zh: 我感觉昏昏沉沉的。我昨晚几乎没怎么睡。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Maybe change out of your pajamas and get some coffee.
dialogue.zh: 也许先把睡衣换掉，再喝点咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Good idea. I need something to wake me up.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。我需要点东西让我清醒起来。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You're awfully quiet this morning.
dialogue.zh: 你今天早上怎么这么安静？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Give me ten minutes. I'm not a morning person.
dialogue.zh: 给我十分钟。我不是早上状态很好的人。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Bad night's sleep?
dialogue.zh: 昨晚没睡好吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Not really. I'm just always a little grumpy when I first wake up.
dialogue.zh: 也不是。我刚醒的时候就是总有点起床气。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Coffee first, conversation later?
dialogue.zh: 先喝咖啡，等会儿再聊天？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Exactly.
dialogue.zh: 没错。

alternatives.zh: 我睡得太沉，闹钟响了都没醒。

alternatives.en: I didn't hear my alarm go off.
I must've turned my alarm off in my sleep.
alternatives.zh: 我肯定睡着时把闹钟关掉了。
我还处于半睡半醒状态。

alternatives.en: I need coffee before I can function.
alternatives.zh: 我得先喝咖啡才能正常运转。

expressions.zh: 我不是晨型人；我早上通常状态不好。

alternatives.en: I'm always a little grumpy when I first wake up.
alternatives.zh: 我刚醒的时候总有点起床气。

alternatives.en: Give me a few minutes to wake up.

example.en: I woke up at seven, but I didn't get up until seven-thirty.
example.zh: 我七点醒了，但七点半才真正起床。

practice.title: Mini Role-play A · 睡过头
practice.context: 你 8:10 才醒，但 8:30 必须出门。
practice.promptEn: Hey, aren't you supposed to be at work soon?
practice.promptZh: 嘿，你不是马上就该去上班了吗？
targets: turn off my alarm — 关掉闹钟
miss the bus — 没赶上公交车

practice.title: Mini Role-play B · 周末赖床
practice.context: 周末上午快十一点，你还躺在床上。
practice.promptEn: Are you seriously still in bed? It's almost eleven.
practice.promptZh: 你不会真的还在床上吧？都快十一点了。
targets: go back to sleep — 再睡着
not be a morning person — 不是晨型人

practice.title: Quick Rewrite · 改成自然美语

items.source: I woke up late and now I am hurried.
items.better: I overslept, and now I'm in a rush.
items.zh: 我睡过头了，现在特别赶。

items.source: My alarm rang, but I pressed the delay button.
items.better: My alarm went off, but I hit the snooze button.
items.zh: 我的闹钟响了，但我按了贪睡按钮。
